snapshot_label: Latest common model-evaluable historical-input demo (2025 period 21; nominal period end 2 Dec 2025)
source: Prepared satellite-derived vegetation and environmental observations, seasonal anomaly tables, and saved XGBoost model artifacts supplied with the project.
risk_definition: Risk score = empirical percentile (0–100) of predicted vegetation-stress severity (-predicted anomaly) against 2015–2022 target anomalies for the same source period and horizon. It is a relative index, not a probability.
top_factors_method: Per-cell TreeSHAP contribution magnitude from the saved model. Factors are model associations, not causal explanations.
geometry_note: Map polygons are approximate squares reconstructed from each centroid and area; they are not official cadastral or administrative boundaries.
disclaimer: Satellite-derived vegetation anomaly risk indicator; not a field-verified desertification diagnosis, not a causal claim, and not a live forecast.
limitations: No 2026 inputs were supplied; the demo uses the latest common model-evaluable 2025 period.
The map is retrospective and intended for product demonstration and decision support.
Field observations are required before operational or land-management decisions.
The risk index is calibrated to historical seasonal distributions and must not be read as probability.
